answer: What survives to the dune is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the knoll of a task receipt, and the vertex is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
